# Vladislav Kurguzov

> Senior product designer with 5+ years. I find the real problem, untangle the chaos and make the process work. Fintech, AI tools, design systems, DesignOps. I design and also write the code for my own tools.

- Site: https://krgzv.net/
- Based in Almaty, Kazakhstan; works remotely

## What I do

- Product design for large consumer and business products: web and mobile, research to release
- Untangling stuck decisions between business, brand and users, then shipping the fix
- DesignOps: Figma plugins and widgets, design systems, team processes
- AI in design work: knowledge bases that let an LLM build pages from a design system
- Prototyping and front-end code (I build my own Figma plugins and side products)

## Experience

- Alfa-Bank — Senior Product Designer, website (merchant acquiring, DesignOps, AI track), 2024 – now
- red_mad_robot (Central Asia) — Product Designer / DesignOps, design system for Home Credit Bank Business, 2024
- Zimran — Product Designer, EdTech, 2023 – 2024

- Alfa-Bank Kazakhstan — Product Designer, 2021 – 2022

## Case studies

- [Ending a two-year stand-off over how terminals look](https://krgzv.net/cases/terminals.html): business wanted photos, brand guidelines banned them; I unblocked it with hyper-real 3D, then turned a block refresh into a terminal showcase with a comparison table and a 30-second quiz. Applications started by visitors grew +38% in the quarter after release; research issues with choosing a terminal went from 3 to 0.
- [When 30% of sales leads are support calls](https://krgzv.net/cases/support.html): existing clients used the new-client form to reach support; I routed them to the right line before and inside the form and went after the root cause.
- [Testing a new tariff calculator inside the real page in two days](https://krgzv.net/cases/calculator.html): I built a working calculator prototype with AI (Figma Make, GitHub Pages) and embedded it into the site page through the site's iframe widget, so research checked the new calculator instead of the old one; none of 8 respondents noticed it was a prototype. The redesign — one tariff card format, cards that swap places as inputs change, commission shown in steps like a receipt, industry search — raised CR1 (visitors who start an application) by 5% against the old calculator in an A/B test.
- [One designer, one plugin, every designer on the site](https://krgzv.net/cases/plugin.html): a Figma plugin I designed and coded solo; one click instead of 40–60 minutes of image assembly, used by all 30+ site designers, plus AI page generation from a knowledge base I designed.
- [Paying for public transport with a QR code](https://krgzv.net/cases/qr.html): field research on buses, the flow cut from 9 screens to 3, 20 seconds faster per payment, +17% riders paying in the app.
